purpose: Declares safe local preview/contact-sheet paths for donor/reference asset sources. The manifest stores metadata only and does not include raw third-party art.

rules.restrictedSources: may display local reference previews in dev/editor tools only; must not become runtime assets by previewing them
rules.releaseBuild: must not include restricted/local preview contact sheets unless licensing and redistribution policy explicitly allow it
